import math
R=45
r=7.5
pitch=42
height=210
path=cq.Wire.makeHelix(pitch,height+pitch,R)
profile=cq.Workplane(cq.Plane(origin=(R,0,0),normal=(0,R,pitch/(2*math.pi)),xDir=(1,0,0))).circle(r)
spring=profile.sweep(cq.Workplane(obj=path),isFrenet=True).val().translate((0,0,-pitch/2)).rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),-180)
clip=cq.Workplane('XY').box(150,150,height,centered=(True,True,False)).val()
result=spring.intersect(clip)
